title: Python and packages
intro: Python 3 and pip are installed. Popular packages install from a copy served by this page, so they work with the internet off.

steps.text: Write a small script into a file.
Run it. riscv64 is the processor this machine emulates.
Install a package. PyYAML is small and installs in seconds.
Bigger packages work too. numpy takes a few minutes to install here.
Start the interactive Python shell. Type exit() to leave.
